description: WCAG contrast ratio with AA/AAA verdicts.

faqs.a: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 and L2 are the relative luminances of the lighter and darker colors, exactly as WCAG 2.x defines it.
AA needs 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (18pt+, or 14pt+ bold). AAA needs 7:1 normal and 4.5:1 large.
faqs.q: What are the AA and AAA thresholds?

faqs.a: Yes — the preview swaps the two colors as text and background so you can judge both directions visually.
faqs.q: Can I preview the colors together?

howto: Pick the text color and the background color.
The contrast ratio is computed instantly.
Read the PASS/FAIL verdicts for AA and AAA, normal and large text.
